tasks.label: git:status
tasks.command: git status --short; Write-Output '--- log ---'; git log --oneline -5 2>&1; Write-Output '--- remote ---'; git remote -v; Write-Output '--- branch ---'; git branch --show-current; Write-Output '--- identity ---'; git config user.name; git config user.email

tasks.label: git:commit
tasks.command: git add -A; Write-Output '--- staged count ---'; (git diff --cached --name-only | Measure-Object -Line).Lines; Write-Output '--- commit ---'; git commit -F engine/build/commit-msg.txt; Write-Output '--- branch ---'; git branch -M main; git branch --show-current; Write-Output '--- remote ---'; git remote add origin https://github.com/LiiVon/DepScan.git; git remote -v

tasks.label: git:amend
tasks.command: git rm -r --cached samples/demo/.vscode/depscan-cache 2>&1 | Out-Null; git add -A; git commit --amend -F engine/build/commit-msg.txt --quiet; Write-Output '--- files ---'; (git ls-files | Measure-Object -Line).Lines; Write-Output '--- utf8 names ---'; git -c core.quotepath=false ls-files docs/ samples/; Write-Output '--- head ---'; git log --oneline -1
